dezeeuw_map.chosen_route: use de Zeeuw's direct affine map, not the longer Klein-quadric route
dezeeuw_map.fixed_geometry: choose lambda as the z-axis and pi as the affine plane x=1 after a generic rotation or extension
dezeeuw_map.incidence_dictionary: p in q iff phi(p) intersects psi(q)
dezeeuw_map.pairwise_disjointness: generic positioning lets the phi-family and psi-family be pairwise disjoint inside each side, so incidence multiplicity equals bipartite line intersections
dezeeuw_map.plane_map: a plane q is sent to a line psi(q) in the same parameter space
dezeeuw_map.point_map: a point p is sent to a line phi(p) in the parameter space of lines meeting lambda and pi

kollar_subatoms.content: construct a surface of degree O(|L|^(1/2)) containing all lines of L
count intersections with M-lines not contained in the interpolating surface by degree times |M|
charge plane/quadric components to t|L|+s|M| using the refined degeneracy hypothesis
use ruled-surface structure and positive-characteristic degree cutoff to bound remaining line intersections

line_intersection_atom.line_sets: finite line families L and M in F^3 with |L|<=|M|
line_intersection_atom.quadric_degeneracy: no quadric contains s lines of L and t lines of M
line_intersection_atom.why_this_is_now_the_only_internal_gap: the de Zeeuw map and the reciprocal-energy parameter ledger are elementary reductions once this line-intersection bound is available

plain_conclusion: 当前唯一内部自足线继续下钻：Rudnev 点-平面 incidence 不再作为整体黑箱，已选定 de Zeeuw 的直接映射路线，把点-平面 incidence 转为两族空间直线的二分交点计数。点-平面到线交点的代数字典、refined Rudnev 退化账本和正特征 |P|=O(p^2) 截断已形成可审查接口。真正剩余缩成二分 Guth-Katz/Kollár 线交点界及其插值曲面/ruled-surface 证明包；因此 row_column_unconditional_closed 仍保持 false。

refined_rudnev_statement.input: finite point set P and plane set Q in F^3 with |P|<=|Q|
refined_rudnev_statement.refined_degeneracy: no affine line contains s points of P and is contained in t planes of Q
refined_rudnev_statement.standard_rudnev_recovery: taking s=k and t=1 gives |P|^(1/2)|Q|+|P|+k|Q|, and |P| is absorbed by the main term since |P|<=|Q|

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把唯一内部自足剩余锁定为 Rudnev 点-平面 incidence 自足证明。
选择 de Zeeuw 直接点-平面到线-线交点路线，避免回到 RKS23/inverse-sumproduct 回环。
点 p 与平面 q 的 incidence 被转写为两条参数空间直线 phi(p), psi(q) 的相交。
Rudnev 点-平面估计已归约为二分线交点界加 quadric 退化账本。
|L|=O(p^2) 对应插值曲面次数 O(|L|^1/2)
尚未在合著稿内自足写出二分 Guth-Katz/Kollár 线交点界证明。
插值曲面、单 ruled/非 ruled 分量和正特征次数截断仍需作者侧内联。
点-平面证明已压成线交点证明包，但该包未内联前不能算闭合。
RNRS/Rudnev 自足输入仍依赖上述点-平面 incidence 证明包。
本步继续压缩唯一剩余；未宣称行/列命题无条件闭合。
